indexes.name: idx_issues_ready
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_issues_ready
        ON issues(status, priority, created_at)
        WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
        AND ephemeral = 0
        AND pinned = 0
        AND (is_template = 0 OR is_template IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_issues_priority_created_at
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_issues_priority_created_at ON issues(priority ASC, created_at DESC)
